_comment: Synthetic `snyk test --json` (Open Source) fixture. Models the output shape of Snyk CLI v1.1306.3 (the snyk-version pinned in reusable-snyk-policy-reconcile.yml). These tests are black-box against frozen fixtures, so they CANNOT detect a Snyk JSON schema change on their own. When bumping snyk-version, re-check that `vulnerabilities[].id` and `filtered.ignore[].id` still match real output and update these fixtures if the shape changed. The reconcile script ignores unknown top-level keys, so this field is inert.
